summary: The PR only guards `__lt__` (`<`) against None, but the issue reports that `>`, `<=`, and `>=` crash identically. I confirmed `<` now skips None while `<=`, `>`, `>=` still raise TypeError on None values. The fix needs to be applied to all four comparison operators.
